title: lantana junelliana
intro: Lantana junelliana, commonly known as the Island Kalmia or Junellia junelliana, is a species of flowering plant in the family Verbenaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and fight off pathogens due to its antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Lantana junelliana include its use in traditional medicine to treat various conditions, such as wounds, fever, and respiratory issues, attributed to its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Lantana junelliana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its full range of benefits and potential applications.
